nom: CeraVe Brightening Vitamin C Cleanser for Dull & Uneven Skin Tone

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers form a large share of the feedback and mostly report no irritation, with several specifically noting it didn't worsen rosacea or reactive skin.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: most report no extra dryness and some say it didn't bother their dry, sensitive skin at all, but a few say it left their face feeling tight and needing a moisturizer straight after washing.
segments.oily: The oily-skin reports are limited but positive, including one reviewer whose partner's oily skin looked glowier with less oil production after switching to this cleanser.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser doesn't strip or dry out their skin, but several say it left their face feeling tight or requiring an immediate moisturizer, particularly those with drier skin.
concerns.redness: The reviewers who mention redness, including one with rosacea, report this cleanser reduced redness rather than aggravating it.
concerns.spots: Reports on dullness and dark spots are mixed: many reviewers say their skin tone became more even or dark spots faded with consistent use over weeks, while others, especially those with only mild discoloration to begin with, saw no noticeable brightening.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the cleanser didn't cause new breakouts and some say it helped reduce them, including one who noted it also reduced redness from acne.
concerns.oiliness: The limited oily-skin feedback is positive, with one reviewer's partner seeing reduced oil production and a fresher-looking face.

aspects.libelle: Lathers well and rinses off cleanly
Thin, runny consistency with less lather than expected
Large bottle seen as good value and long-lasting
Label's 7-day sun-avoidance instruction seen as impractical

extraits.titre: Nice cleanser, not great smell IMO
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got this in May and it's July as I'm writing this and I use it about once a week. This isn't my go to cleanser for everyday so keep all of this in mind! My skin tone wasn't too bad so I wasn't worried about using it often to drastically change my skin tone. First off, I do not like the smell and I think it's the vitamin c because I got a shampoo that also has vitamin c in it and I don't like that smell either. It lathers up really nice and I don't feel any drier than I usually do after washing my face. I have used ones in the past that leave my face feeling like SpongeBob in the episode at Sandy's house. It feels like it has brightened up my face a little bit, I haven't noticed a difference in the spots on my face that I was feeling had some uneven-ness. Overall, it's not a bad skin cleanser, I just wasn't overly impressed with it? I think if I used it daily I would probably be able to more accurately address it but since I was going into summer and being in the sun almost daily, I didn't want to use this too too much. Make sure you wear sunscreen if you use this!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser was tested on both my sensitive dry skin and my partners oily skin. We felt like this cleanser was better for oily skin as it left a nice glow and lessened oil productions and left his face feeling fresh. For me it worked nicely under the cerave moisturizer but did not provide lasting hydration. Overall best for oily skin if you want a nice cleanser that creates glowy skin.

extraits.titre: Have to use the combo cleaner + gel
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This facial cleanser did a job because my skin is cleaner affer the 1st use and brighter after couple weeks. However, I always have to apply moisturizer on my face after using this cleaner because my skin feel dry and tight affer the wash. It will make my experiment better if this product had scent. But I still want to reccomend to give this product a try because the result it makes.

extraits.titre: Leaves skin feeling fresh and clean
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. As someone with very dry, sensitive skin, I have to be careful what products I use. I had good luck with Cerave products in the past, and using it this time was no different. The bottle is a good size and lasts a long time. I've been using it for over a month and still have between half and 3/4 of the bottle left. It foams up nicely when you use it and definitely gives you a nice, clean feeling after. It doesn't leave any heavy/oily residue. It didn't bother my dry/sensitive skin, which was great because so many products do. I think this would be good for all skin types. Another winner. Highly recommend!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is an amazing product. It is good for sensitive skin, and it does not have any scent. An added bonus is that it is helping to fade my dark spots, something I have never had a cleanser do! Also love the pump packaging which is great. Cerave has amazing products within a good price point. I definitely will be purchasing once this is finished.

extraits.titre: This cleanser is effective, gentle on the skin, and a great
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed after every use. The rinsing process is quick and easy with no residue left behind. Its effectiveness stands out by gently cleansing while helping my complexion look brighter over time and I noticed it doesn't make my redness worse or leave my skin feeling tight.
